O.outcome_detail: share of commercial quantum job vacancies by minimum degree requirement

cells.quote: We investigated over 750 vacancies currently available of which 62 percent demand the candidates for a PhD degree. It can be seen that graduates with PhD degrees are by far the most in demand, followed by bachelor’s and master’s graduates.
cells.note: Observational analysis of job vacancies; the study reports degree-requirement frequencies rather than an instructional intervention.

O.outcome_detail: strength of higher-education degree requirements in job vacancies

cells.quote: Furthermore, the requirement of higher education for job vacancies is significantly stronger in Europe than in the US and Canada.
cells.note: Regional comparison from an observational job-database analysis; no instructional treatment or learner sample was reported.

cells.quote: Surprisingly, the majority of the job vacancies demand for bachelor’s graduates in US/Canada compared to Europe/rest.
cells.note: Regional comparison from an observational job-database analysis; the text does not provide a printed effect size.
